name: Credit Card Optimizer Calculator
meta_title: Credit Card Optimizer: Best Way to Split Your Payment
meta_description: Split one monthly budget across several credit cards to pay the least interest. Compare with an even split and test moving balances to a new low-rate card.
subtitle: Enter your cards and the total you can pay each month to see how to split it for the least interest, how that compares with dividing it evenly, and what a balance transfer card would add.
